sentences.text: On 1.31, you must enable the `ImageVolume` feature gate, as the feature is in alpha state (feature gate `ImageVolume`).
On 1.31, you mount an OCI image as a volume by specifying an `image` volume source, which represents an OCI object available on the kubelet's host machine.

citations.quote: An `image` volume source represents an OCI object (a container image or artifact) which is available on the kubelet's host machine.

gaps: The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.
